name: LightMem

paper.title: LightMem: Lightweight and Efficient Memory-Augmented Generation

construction.unit: entry {topic, summary embedding, user turn, model turn}
construction.processing: LLMLingua-2 token compression; attention+similarity topic segmentation; LLM summarizes each topic group
construction.writer: backbone LLM (GPT-4o-mini / Qwen3-30B-A3B / GLM-4.6); LLMLingua-2 compresses

organization.structure: flat LTM; sensory and STM are transient buffers
organization.stores: one LTM store (512-token sensory buffer, th-token STM buffer before it)

management.operations: test-time soft insert only; offline parallel LLM update (add/delete/update/merge)
management.conflicts: each entry's queue: top-k similar entries with later timestamps may update it

retrieval.candidates: cosine similarity over all LTM entry embeddings
retrieval.selection: top-k; retriever and k shared with baselines (k value not stated)

use.context: retrieved entries appended to the query

stages.ingestion: Turns are fed one at a time; LLMLingua-2 pre-compresses each turn (keep tokens above the r-th percentile of retention probability) into a 512-token sensory buffer.
stages.construction: When the sensory buffer fills, topic boundaries are the intersection of LLMLingua-2 attention local maxima and low adjacent-turn embedding similarity; topic groups enter an STM buffer and, at threshold th tokens, the backbone LLM summarizes each topic group into entries {topic, embedding(summary), user turn, model turn}.
stages.organization: Flat long-term store of topic-indexed entries (summary embedding plus compressed original turns).
stages.update: Test time: soft update (direct insertion only). Sleep time: for each entry an update queue of top-k similar, later-timestamped entries is built and backbone-LLM updates run offline in parallel.
stages.retrieval: Cosine-similarity vector retrieval (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), same retriever and number of retrieved entries as baselines.
stages.answer: Retrieved entries are appended to the query for the chat model (same backbone as memory model).

summary: Atkinson-Shiffrin-inspired pipeline: token-level pre-compression and topic segmentation (sensory), topic-batched summarization (STM), and offline parallel 'sleep-time' LTM updates, cutting memory-construction tokens and API calls by 1-2 orders of magnitude.
notes:
AXES CORRECTED from the paper; earlier taxonomy row was: MTM entry | compressed | SLM write, offline LTM graph | STM/MTM/LTM | vector 2K -> SLM filter K. AXES-CHECK: the paper disagrees with the seed taxonomy row in several places. (1) Stages are sensory memory -> STM -> LTM; there is no 'MTM'. (2) Entries are written by the backbone LLM (GPT-4o-mini / Qwen3-30B-A3B / GLM-4.6); the small model (LLMLingua-2) only compresses tokens and gives attention for topic segmentation, it does not write entries. (3) LTM is a flat store of entries with an offline parallel update; no graph (a KG is listed only as future work). (4) Retrieval is plain cosine top-k with all-MiniLM-L6-v2; the paper describes no '2K candidates -> SLM filter K' stage (that may come from a later code release; not verified). VENUE: the seed taxonomy listed an ACL version, but LightMem was accepted at ICLR 2026 (OpenReview dyJ0GWpjJB, ICLR 2026 poster; GitHub README). No ACL version found; the same group's StructMem was accepted at ACL 2026, and EverMemOS is ACL 2026 - possibly the source of the mix-up. Numbers taken from the latest arXiv HTML (which adds LoCoMo and GLM-4.6; the v1 abstract covered only LongMemEval).
DESIGN: Sec 3.1-3.3, 5.1, App. A.1 (Tables 4-5), C.1, D. Corrected prefill: 'offline LTM update' moved from construction.processing to management; structure clarified as flat LTM (sensory/STM are buffers, no MTM, no graph); unit made concrete. Nulls: forgetting (no deletion policy beyond LLM update ops), retrieval budget (number of retrieved entries not stated).
